name: Night Train Viaduct
description: A night train crosses a tall stone viaduct above a moonlit river. A steam locomotive with turning wheels and side rods pulls carriages whose lit windows show passengers, its headlamp sweeps the rails ahead and a plume of steam trails behind, a signal turns red as it passes, and a mountain village glows on the hillside under the stars. Optional snowfall and blue hour. Code-drawn, entirely offline.
author: seeWallpaper
